title: Zero´s Qol
description: List of Qol nad vanilla+ mods combined into a perfect survival modpack.
body: Modpack adds a bunch of resource pack and other Qol mods such as Xaero´s minimap, Copper pipes, Charms, Distant horizons and so on. So if you are looking for a modpack to start your journey of moded minecraft this is a great choice. (modpack does not need any external dependecies or mods)
